caption:
My kid just marched into the room and handed me this. 

It’s made of cardboard, crooked cuts, and way too much tape. 

An official award for "being the best at finding lost Lego pieces under the couch." 

Easily the best thing I've been handed all year.

history.caption:
My son handed me this after school today. 

No jury, no red carpet—just some crooked scissor cuts and a lot of tape. 

Apparently, it’s for "being the best at finding lost Lego pieces." 

Honestly, nothing else I build is ever going to top this.
